notes:
Mid-market analytics SaaS (product usage + help center). Initial contact via content trial -> demo in Jan. Primary contact: CTO (Ravi Patel) + Head of Platform (Laura Kim). They started with Hosted API POC (chat + doc search) to validate accuracy and latency. POC ran for 6 weeks: ~1.2M tokens/month, peak 60 rps indexing, average chat session 80 tokens. Early findings: relevance strong, hallucination low for product docs, but cost per active user higher than target.

Current direction: evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and to enable VPC controls. Request: can Redwood host hybrid model — Hosted for dev, Dedicated for prod — with same routing and transparent fallbacks? They asked for an apples-to-apples unit economics comparison (tokens/1000, peak v sustained throughput, batching gains) and a P&L for replacing current embedding pipeline. Security asks: SOC2 evidence, SSO test, ability to bring KMS keys, audit export cadence.

Workshop planned: 2026-03-10 cost-optimization session with AE/SE/Dev team. Agenda: quantify batching benefit for their chat workload, KV/prefix caching patterns for repeated queries across product pages, quantization profiles tradeoffs (fp16 vs int8 -> latency & quality), and run a toy cost model comparing Hosted vs Dedicated at varying QPS. SE note: prefer to show real traces from POC (we have anonymized telemetry).

Quotes: "If we can drop per-active-user inference cost by 40% with predictable latency, we can move to Dedicated" — CTO. "Need 95th percentile chat latency <250ms for US region, otherwise UX suffers" — Head of Platform.

Open items: finalize Dedicated sizing (GPU types), confirm cold-start penalty w/ autoscale, SLA language for latency, and procurement paperwork (PO + SOW).
